title: xylosma coriacea
intro: Xylosma coriacea, commonly known as the Small-leaf Xylosma or West Indian Xylosma, is a plant species in the family Salicaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Xylosma coriacea include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Xylosma coriacea have been found to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its potential health benefits.
